A case marked batched was sent as one paragraph of a document of up to 150 inputs joined by blank lines, and its html is that paragraph; every other case was sent alone. The attributes GitHub adds per request or for layout (data-run-id, the style on <math-renderer>, the footnote IDs' hash and data-footnote attributes) are removed.
